subject: APPLIED air-compute-opus: AIR-only compute codegen wired (shared tree); HEAVY TAKE host mesa-build Mali (build_callable_compilers.py -j2 nice)
body: Files: NEW mali_compute_air.inc b56d4480, NEW air_json.h 6d58511b, mali_compute_compiler.c 46a0b6fc (compile_compute split: SPIR-V frontend + shared compute_backend tail; SPIR-V path byte-identical on 367/367 UI+CA kernels vs host f71ef79f), mali_compute_compiler.h 5b2ad167 (+tegu_mali_compile_compute_air, struct tegu_mali_air_compute), runtime_pipeline.inc (tegu_compute_compile: creation/TGP1 dispatch/TGP2 region compile from AIR + base m2v metadata; TEGU_AIR_COMPUTE / TEGU_AIR_DIRECT env, -DTEGU_AIR_COMPUTE_DEFAULT=1; refusal -> TEGU_AIR_REFUSED kernel ..., no m2v code), compute_frontend.m (TeguPipeline ivar airSource + dealloc free only), build_native_compilers.py/build_callable_compilers.py (copy list +mali_compute_air.inc,air_json.h). Private replay (UI+CA kernels 373): region compile AIR ok 342 (ABI vs m2v: manifests identical except m2v-only dummy sampler record [runtime subtracts it], TLS sizes, and local = exact region local where m2v emitted a flattened (64,1,1) that the runtime's local check would reject); refused 27 (simd_shuffle_down 16 [frontend], tile functions 4 [not used by runtime], 32-lane cross-lane simd_sum 1 = CA compute_apl_fast, descriptor arrays 2, pointer phi 2, BicubicTexels 1, simdgroup.barrier 1, repack bitcast 1). Known gap: dispatches that select an m2v dispatch VARIANT are refused under AIR-only until the bridge exports the variant metadata (additive air_bridge.rs function, next).
